title: Visual Schedule for Kids, Printable Routine Chart Bundle, Morning Bedtime Chore Chart, 96 Picture Cards, English French Bilingual
description:
Tired of repeating "shoes, coat, backpack" ten times before school? Riverbank Routines turns the day into pictures your child can follow and move to All done.

One complete system, not a single chart: 30 printable pages in 4 themes, in English, French or bilingual (English + French on every card), Letter and A4.

What's inside:
• My day board (10 steps + All done), First / Then, Now / Next / Later, Today's plan (morning, afternoon, evening)
• Morning, after-school and bedtime routine charts, plus a blank one for your own steps
• Helping-at-home chart with space for your own chores
• Toilet steps picture strip
• Raindrop jar token boards (5 and 10 drops), 30 cut-out raindrops and "I did it!" badges
• 96 picture cards in two sizes (52 mm and 38 mm): morning, school and outings, play, meals, helping at home, bedtime, feelings and special days, including "Change of plan"
• Blank cards and labels
• Calm theme: a low-stimulation set with muted colours and no background decoration
• Fillable: type your child's name, your own routine steps and blank card labels on screen before printing. What you type stays in your own file on your own device.
• Quick-start guide in English and French

How it works: download, print at 100% (cardstock lasts longest), cut, laminate if you like, add hook-and-loop dots, and build the day together.

Good to know:
• Digital download. Nothing is shipped.
• For your own family or your own single classroom.
• French uses Canadian words (déjeuner, dîner, souper, mitaines).
• This is an organising tool for families. It is not medical, sleep, toileting or developmental advice. For health questions, talk to your child's doctor.
• The illustrations are original Steadfold artwork, created with AI assistance and finished, checked and assembled by Steadfold.
• Launch sale: 30% off until 30 Nov 2026. Regular price CA$14.99.

Questions? Message the shop any time.
